prompt: write an unaware giantess story about a guy getting accidentally shipped to his daughter after being shrunk down to an inch tall and put inside a clear butplug. The package was meant to go to his wife but he mixed up the addresses before shrinking himself. his daughter has IBS. he encounters runny stool and she expels him after morning coffee.
response: Once upon a time, a father was accidentally shrunk down to an inch tall and packaged inside a clear butplug. The package was meant for his wife, but due to a mix-up, it was sent to his daughter. She had IBS, and after morning coffee, she expelled him. The father found himself in a new world, navigating the challenges of being tiny and trying to find his way back home.
